records.title: Bootstrap Your Own Skills: Learning to Solve New Tasks with Large Language Model Guidance
records.reason: BOSS uses LLM calls to propose/label skill chains during a robot-policy bootstrapping phase, then trains a language-conditioned policy and grows a skill library. It is an agent/robot learning workflow, not an optimization of LLM inference or a measured reduction in deployed LLM serving.

records.title: SFT-then-RL Outperforms Mixed-Policy Methods for LLM Reasoning
records.reason: SFT-then-RL compares post-training schedules for reasoning quality; it does not propose an inference-time efficiency technique.

records.title: Learning Vision-Language-Action World Models for Autonomous Driving
records.reason: This VLA paper concerns autonomous-driving perception/reasoning/control capabilities, without an abstract-level inference resource optimization.

records.title: Learning to Hint for Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: Learning to Hint addresses advantage collapse in GRPO training; it does not target deployed inference efficiency.
